author: TheColdCrafter
body:
Ok, so when i came to this server, the only thing i would ever play was walls. Why? because the maps were fun to memorize and the pvp was challenging, so all in all it was fun and i enjoyed it until i got banned. then i come back and see all the walls maps are based off of whoever gets the op items in the chests and it isn't even fun anymore. the maps aren't fun to play on, or challenging.
Examples:
Knights tower- Basically whoever gets the most chests on this map wins, not to say the map isn't really fun to play on much
Mesoplanet- once again, too many op chests and whoever memorizes where the diamonds are and knows where the op chests are is always the winner.

I'm not saying these maps aren't well made, they just aren't fun to play on, and i think a lot of people agree with me. Now I'm not saying bring back the old maps from MCzone, i know we cant do that, I'm just recommending that people make maps more like those not just with a million designs and op chests, but ones that actually bring in a survival element and make it challenging to get armor and to win the game. examples of maps like this:
Tetris swamp/winter/jungle: these maps are fun to play on, but mix in chests and not too much op stuff but is possible for anyone to win, good gameplay, fun things to do,
The Village - Everyone loves this map. MCzone classic, amazing gameplay, maybe a little bit too op chests but otherwise amazing and really fun to play on
''
This is not an attempt to make everyone mad, I'm just saying this might help more people play walls, and bring some more players to walls, because i remember when it was hard to get to a walls game that wasn't full, and that was FUN. so hopefully you take these ideas into consideration, and maybe work on them.

Thanks,

-Cold

replies.author: Coco_stag
replies.body:
I disagree,
Yes, Some people play walls lots more than others so they know better stuff than the others. I don't think I would say maps have op items. Only Grun Kaskade (I know it was changed) and that is pretty much it. Walls isn't about op items; It's not about who gets the best stuff. Walls is all about preparation, PvP skills, Finding decent items, Conserving time and teamwork. I hate maps like Vanilla, The walls and all those plain maps. They all get full iron and then you just try killing everyone. Maps like Grun Kaskade are fun maps. It depends on how much you take walls into your own hand. I don't wanna brag but I am one of those pretty good walls players. I downloaded maps from other people and broke blocks. I tried finding diamonds until I found them. I mined and mined and found better stuff. I then looked for chests by knowing the person who created the map I know some of the things they would do. It's all about how you deal with this situation
Imagine if most maps were like vanilla. It would ruin the gamemode, You think about it, everyone getting full iron, every single round. How boring would that be? I am telling you now, that would not be fun. I prefer getting rekt by a full diamond.
